translations.web: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
translations.bsb: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
translations.kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
